    # Ensure title isn't some malformed header or blank

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1556, access_token=simple_token)
content = note['content']
lines = content.splitlines()

movies=[]

i=0
while i < len(lines):
    raw = lines[i]
    title = raw.strip()
    if not title or title.startswith('#') or title.startswith('-'):
        i += 1
        continue
    # Titles are plain text lines not containing ':' (avoid metadata-like lines)
    if ':' in title:
        i += 1
        continue

    # Gather metadata lines following this title until we hit next title (non-empty, non-comment, non-dash, no ':')
    director=None
    # Lookahead for metadata lines starting with '-'
    j = i+1
    while j < len(lines):
        nxt = lines[j].strip()
        if not nxt:
            j += 1
            continue
        if nxt.startswith('#'):
            j += 1
            continue
        if nxt.startswith('-'):
            if nxt.lower().startswith('- director:'):
                director = nxt.split(':',1)[1].strip()
            j += 1
            continue
        # if next non-metadata line is a new title
        if (not nxt.startswith('-')) and (not nxt.startswith('#')) and (':' not in nxt):
            break
        # otherwise unknown line; just advance
        j += 1

    if director is not None and 'Quentin Tarantino' in director:
        movies.append(title)

    i = j

# remove exact duplicates preserving order
seen=set(); ordered=[]
for t in movies:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t)
        ordered.append(t)

message = ', '.join(ordered)
print('parsed_tarantino_titles', ordered)
print('message', message)

# Previously sent message was printed in earlier run; but we can't access it.
# We'll just send the correct message anyway.

send_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=laura_phone, message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

# Mark task complete in supervisor
apis.supervisor.complete_task()
